description: This Java class 'LoanCOBJobParameterProvider' provides job parameters for a loan close-of-business (COB) job, including handling business date parameters and interacting with a repository to save job parameter data.

classes.name: LoanCOBJobParameterProvider
classes.description: A Spring component that provides job parameters for the Loan COB process, including handling business date logic and saving parameters via a repository.

methods.name: provide
methods.description: Generates and saves job parameters, returning a map with the custom job parameter ID.

methods.name: getJobName
methods.description: Returns the name of the job, 'LOAN_COB'.

methods.name: getJobParameterDTOListWithCorrectBusinessDate
methods.description: Ensures the job parameter set includes the correct business date parameter, adding it if missing.
